strategy.observation: Transistor reported 24% year-over-year growth in new customers in the month preceding its growth update.
strategy.offer_link: A referral partnership could connect suitable B2B customers with audio editing and show-notes services alongside Transistor’s hosting. For the Partnerships Lead, this is a potential complementary service partnership, rather than a pitch for Transistor to outsource its own production.
hypotheses: Some new Transistor customers may be B2B brands that need outside help editing episodes and writing show notes.
The Partnerships Lead may be interested in referring customers to complementary production providers.
Production support may help those customers publish consistently after choosing a hosting platform.
strategy.angle: Transistor reported 24% year-over-year growth in new customers in your recent update—would an editing and show-notes referral option for B2B podcasts be worth exploring?
strategy.fit_reason: Podcast production complements podcast hosting, and a referral arrangement is relevant to a partnerships role. The opportunity depends on unconfirmed demand from B2B customers and Transistor’s willingness to partner with service providers.

draft.subject: Referral option for B2B podcasts
draft.body:
Hi — I noticed Transistor reported 24% year-over-year growth in new customers in your recent update.

My guess is some of those new accounts are B2B brands that want help getting episodes edited and show notes written once they’ve chosen a host.

I handle podcast audio editing and show notes for B2B teams, so the idea here would be a simple referral option for customers who need production support, not a change to Transistor’s hosting.

If that’s on your radar, who’s the right person to speak with about a partner like this?
